description: Up to three years of filed annual accounts for a Norwegian company: revenue, operating and net profit, payroll, assets, equity, debt and cash, with growth, margin and equity ratio. Set consolidated for group accounts.

consolidated.description: Return the group (konsern) accounts instead of the company accounts; only parent companies file them.

organizationNumber.description: Nine-digit Norwegian organisation number, such as 923609016.

name: get_norwegian_company_financials
title: Get Norwegian company financials
